Product Details

The Arteor range product with CAT number 575824 is a 3 Module Cover Plate with Overmoulded Frame in Champagne color, designed for mechanism mounting. It supports both flush and surface-mounted installations and is made from high-quality materials, including a polycarbonate front plate, acrylonitrile butadiene styrene underplate, and galvanized steel frame. The product ensures safety with self-extinguishing properties at 650°C for 30 seconds.
